editorial:
Imagine you are a typical teenager who just wants a whirlwind romance. That is exactly where you find yourself as Nicole. When you meet David, he seems like the perfect guy. He is handsome, charming, and treats you like a queen. The movie starts off feeling like a sweet love story, but the vibe shifts quickly. You will feel the tension build as David's love turns into a scary obsession. He starts controlling every part of your life, and the dream date turns into a total nightmare. It is a wild ride that shows how a red flag can be ignored when you are blinded by a crush.

What really makes this work is the acting. Mark Wahlberg is terrifyingly good at playing the bad boy who snaps. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the drama feels a bit over the top. If you love old-school thrillers, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture quality. It is a great choice for a rainy weekend when you want something exciting.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a massive fight at Nicole's house. David completely loses it and tries to kill her and her family. After a scary chase through the home, Nicole finally finds the strength to fight back. She manages to get the upper hand and kills David to save herself. The movie wraps up with the family safe, showing that the nightmare is finally over and Nicole is free from his grip.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about dangerous obsessions.
